test(hooks): add behavioral regression test for no-push-to-main.sh

No hook under .claude/hooks/ had a behavioral test before this --
only shellcheck via make lint-shell. Exercises the worktree
branch-resolution fix and the quote/heredoc false-positive fix from the
previous commit: a feature branch pushed from its own worktree is
allowed, a push on main or targeting main/master is still denied, and
the push phrase inside a grep pattern, an echo argument, or a heredoc
body is inert rather than an invocation. Builds a disposable git repo
plus worktree under TMPDIR, pipes crafted PreToolUse JSON into the hook,
and asserts on permissionDecision -- run once with the real PATH and
once with jq hidden behind a minimal coreutils allowlist, so both the
jq and sed-fallback extraction paths are covered. Confirmed the suite
fails with 10/20 failures against the pre-fix hook and passes clean
against the fix (fidelity check).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)" 2>&1
